newsitem.title: USA: Waxman, Barnett in secondary offering.
newsitem.headline: Waxman, Barnett in secondary offering.

text.p: Waxman Industries Inc through its subsidiary Waxman USA Inc, said Wednesday it has sold 1,125,000 common shares of Barnett Inc at $17.50 in a secondary offering. Barnett said it has sold an additional 375,000 shares at the same price.
The net proceeds amounted to $18.7 million for Waxman and $6.2 million for Barnett.

Waxman will use its share to repay indebtedness. The company said it has now converted all of its Barnett preferred stock to common stock and owns 45.7 percent of the outstanding common stock of Barnett.
Barnett will use the net proceeds to repay all of its indebtedness and for general corporate purposes.

Waxman is a leading supplier to the repair and remodeling market in the United States. Through its wholly owned subsidiaries, Consumer Products, WOC and TWI, and its affiliate, Barnett Inc, it distributes plumbing, electrical and hardware products.
